subject: Decentralized receipt routing & VAT synchronization for multi-entity invoices
messages:
From: Cassandra Price <cassandra.price@novamed.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaMed Finance <finance@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-entity invoice routing for NovaMed pilot

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Procurement here at NovaMed has one follow-up before we sign the SOW: because our clinical operations are billed out of two legal entities (NovaMed UK Ltd and NovaMed Holdings US), we need the invoice and VAT handling to map to those entities and our internal cost centers.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood issue split invoices (single SOW but separate invoice lines and remittance instructions per legal entity)?
- How will VAT be shown for EU deliveries vs. reverse-charge scenarios?
- We need a suggested CSV/XLS layout for our AP system so they can automatically allocate payments to cost centers.

I've attached the PO (PO-44321.pdf) and copied finance. Happy to hop on a call but would appreciate a short playbook we can hand to our AP team.

Thanks,
Cassandra
Cassandra Price
Head of Procurement, NovaMed
attachment: PO-44321.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Cassandra Price <cassandra.price@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoice routing for NovaMed pilot

Hi Cassandra — great to hear and congrats on moving toward signature.

Short answer: yes, we can support split invoicing that maps lines to separate legal entities with per-entity remittance instructions and VAT labeling. I put together a short routing template and a recommended workflow below so your AP can automate allocations. See attached: split_invoice_routing_template.xlsx.

Proposed high-level workflow:
1) Single SOW / single invoice PDF that contains: header summary, then per-entity invoice sections (entity name, invoice number, tax/VAT lines, remittance details).
2) Machine-friendly export (CSV) generated at the same time with one row per invoice line including: entity_id, legal_entity_name, cost_center, net_amount, vat_amount, currency, gl_code, payment_term, remittance_account.
3) For EU customers where reverse-charge applies, we will include VAT summary and a "VAT: reverse charge" flag at the line level.
4) Payment reconciliation: your AP can post payments to the CSV's payment reference (we recommend our invoice number + entity suffix).

Questions for you (so we can finalize the template):
- Exact legal entity names and billing addresses for the two NovaMed entities?
- Do you want separate invoice numbers per legal entity (e.g., INV-2027-001-UK and INV-2027-001-US) or a single invoice with entity suffixes?
- Which cost center fields does your ERP require (cost_center id vs. free-text description)?

Looping in Marissa and Ben from Finance to confirm accounting treatment and any GL suggestions. Laura — friendly FYI for the rollout checklist.

I attached a template and a short spec doc; happy to refine once you send the legal entity details.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
attachment: split_invoice_routing_template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Cassandra Price <cassandra.price@novamed.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoice routing for NovaMed pilot

Hi all — quick note from Finance on implementation constraints and recommendations.

Key recommendations:
- Invoice numbering: we recommend issuing one root invoice number and separate line-level entity identifiers (root INV + entity suffix). This keeps contract traceability and avoids duplicate SOW references in RevRec. Example: INV-2027-104 | lines: INV-2027-104-UK, INV-2027-104-US.
- VAT presentation: include VAT per entity section and an aggregated VAT summary on the first page. For EU reverse-charge lines flag "RC" in the VAT column and include the legal citation (e.g., Art. 44 VAT Directive) in the notes.
- GL mapping: add a gl_code column in the CSV. If NovaMed prefers to map by cost_center id, include both columns (gl_code & cost_center_id).
- Remittance: provide a per-entity remittance_account_id (we'll display this in the PDF and include it in the CSV).

Operational notes:
- We'll produce both a human-readable PDF for auditors and a CSV for AP uploads.
- For card/ACH payments we can accept a single payment and split in our AR ledger to the two entities; for wire transfers we can provide two remittance accounts so NovaMed can route funds directly.

Attached is a short spec with example rows. Priya — if NovaMed wants Docsigned SOW + separate tax addendum, we can prepare doc templates.

Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
attachment: redwood-invoice-split-spec.docx (docx)

From: Cassandra Price <cassandra.price@novamed.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Euan McLeod <euan.mcleod@globalcorp.co.uk>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoice routing for NovaMed pilot

Thanks Priya + Marissa — that is very helpful and aligns with how our AP teams want to consume data.

Action items we will take this week:
- I'll send the exact legal entity names + VAT registration numbers and the preferred cost_center_id format by Friday.
- Procurement prefers separate invoice numbers per entity (INV-2027-104-UK / -US) to simplify ledgers on our side — happy to accept the root number + suffix approach Marissa proposed.
- I'll route the SOW to our legal and provide a signed DocuSign link once countersigned; if Redwood can attach the split-invoice template to the SOW that would save time.

Minor ask: can Redwood add a "tax_flag" column in the CSV with values {standard, reverse_charge, exempt} so our ERP can auto-route VAT treatments? If doable that would be ideal.

Thanks again — we aim to finalize the pilot paperwork next week.

Best,
Cassandra
